# Abstract

This repository contains the SQL model of the _Ros_ database from version **3.1.2** to nowadays.

## Prepare the ros connection file

Create a *JSON* file named ```ros-db.json``` with content:

```json
{
  "host": "localhost",
  "port": "5432",
  "dbname": "IOTC_Ros_3_3_0_2026_04_16",
  "user": "xxx",
  "password": "xxx"
}
```

## Generate database metadata

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Load sources
source("R/common_db_utils.R")
source("R/ros_db_metadata.R")
# Generate Ros dtabase metatadata files
generate_db_metadata(domain = "ALL", extract_db_metadata(schemas = ROS_ALL_SCHEMAS, connection_provider = connect_to_ros), root_directory = DB_METADATA_DIRECTORY)
```
## Update comments on database

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Load sources
source("R/common_db_utils.R")
source("R/ros_db_metadata.R")
# Update for the hole Ros database
ros_update_queries <- apply_comments_on_db(domain = "ALL", root_directory = DB_METADATA_DIRECTORY, connection_provider = connect_to_ros)
```
## Generate database metadata report

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Load sources
source("R/common_db_utils.R")
source("R/common_db_report.R")
source("R/ros_db_metadata.R")
# Generate documentation report of the hole Ros database
ros_db_metadata_generate_report(domain = "ALL", timestamp = DEFAULT_TIME_STAMP)
# Generate documentation report of the PS domain
ros_db_metadata_generate_report(domain = "PS", timestamp = DEFAULT_TIME_STAMP)
# Generate documentation report of the LL domain
ros_db_metadata_generate_report(domain = "LL", timestamp = DEFAULT_TIME_STAMP)
```
